description: What a plan outputs, as data: the closed list of units the execute operators of the same domain do one branch at a time. The unit of a blind agent is one page, one modal, one flow; a table or a module is the same idea for a seed or a backend plan. Every plan operator (<domain>.plan) writes this kind as response/data/units.json and nothing else names a unit: an execute branch carries request.json.unit, which must be an id of a units.json bound as inputs.units (scripts/validate-request.mjs#unitGateErrors). Every unit carries its own goal line, because a unit with no goal is a branch nobody can check. Ids are unique and dependsOn names only ids of the same file; the schema states the shape and the gate that reads the file states those two relations.

producedBy.description: The plan operator that wrote the file; the unit gate checks it is an operator whose Outputs include this kind.

goal.description: The one line the execute branch is checked against; the plan's receipt repeats it beside the unit.

inputs.description: Files the unit's execute branch binds beyond the plan itself, branch-relative (response/...) or session-relative (step-N/parallel-M/response/...).

dependsOn.description: Units that must be done before this one runs; each is an id of this file, so the orchestrator orders the fan-out from the plan alone.
